score_objections.objection: The only source is an August 2026 letter about closing an export-control loophole for U.S. persons working with foreign civilian intelligence agencies (surveillance, cyber, AI tools). It says nothing about semiconductor export controls or chip sales to China, and the item itself concedes this. One tangential letter is too thin to place Welch on the chips scale at all.
